name: cockpit
title: Svala GT cockpit
description: An instrument cluster and touchscreen for Svala GT, a made-up car: open doors on the 3D model, set climate, play media, follow the map, edit every file live.
summary: An instrument cluster over a touchscreen for Svala GT, a made-up car. Press Run to open doors on the 3D car, set the climate, control media and follow the route. Declarative pages sit over strict TypeScript scripts; the drive runs on timers and nothing ticks when nothing changes.
tryThis: Edit any file below and the cockpit rebuilds as soon as it compiles. Try changing the cyan accent in Theme.qml, or edit the first leg of the route in logic/drive.ts.
cardBody: Svala GT, a made-up car: an instrument cluster over a touchscreen with a 3D car whose doors open, climate, media and a map. Opens on its own page where you can press Run and edit every file.

name: watch
title: Kestrel, a smartwatch
description: The software of Kestrel, a made-up smartwatch, running on round and rounded-square screens beside the watch in 3D, with every file open to edit.
summary: The software of Kestrel, a made-up smartwatch, for round and rounded-square screens. Press Run to swipe between screens, turn the crown with the scroll wheel, or let it settle onto its always-on face. Declarative pages sit over strict TypeScript scripts; asleep, only the clock wakes, once a minute.
use: Wear it with the pointer. From the face, swipe up for notifications, down for quick settings and left for the apps; swipe right to go back, and hold the face to change it. The wheel turns the crown; the keys under the watch are its side button and crown, its other screen, and rest. Left alone for fifteen seconds it rests on its always-on face. The 3D watch's case, glass and band are glTF files, which only the WebGPU renderer reads; a browser without WebGPU draws its light strips alone.
tryThis: Edit any file below and the watch rebuilds as soon as it compiles. Try changing the cyan accent in Theme.qml, or the faces themselves in FacePulse.qml and FaceGrid.qml.
cardBody: Kestrel, a made-up smartwatch: two faces, round and rounded-square screens, a scroll-wheel crown, an always-on face and the watch in 3D. Opens on its own page where you can press Run, switch light and dark themes, and edit every file.
cardAlt: A round smartwatch face with neon rings beside the same watch in 3D.
shows: A round smartwatch face with neon rings beside the same watch in 3D, its light strips glowing.

name: agent-built
title: Agent-built (replay)
description: A recorded step-by-step replay of a coding agent editing, checking, auditing, and driving a live dispatch app over MCP.
summary: Watch a recorded MCP session build and verify a live field-service dispatch card for Brekka Grid (a made-up grid operator). Every step shows the exact tool call from ljos mcp and ljos run --mcp — structural QML edits, compiler checks, accessibility snapshot queries, pointer actions, binding inspection, and design contrast audit — replayed against the real running widget on this page. This demo is a recorded replay, not a live LLM connection.
use: The replay plays by itself. Pause it, step back and forth, or press any call in the log to jump to it; the card on the right is the running app, ringed where each call touched it. At step 14 the agent waits for the app to log something: assign a crew to a ticket in the card and the agent reads your pick. The card is yours to use at any step.
tryThis: Press Play to step through the recorded MCP calls, pause on any step to inspect the widget yourself in Observer, or jump to step 5 to see app_audit catch and fix a low-contrast status badge. Edit DispatchCard.qml below and your edit runs in place of the replay.
cardBody: A recorded step-by-step replay of a coding agent editing, checking, auditing, and driving a live dispatch app over MCP. Opens on its own page, where the card it builds runs beside every call.
cardAlt: A split view showing a recorded MCP tool-call log on the left driving a live Brekka Grid dispatch card on the right.
shows: A split view showing a recorded MCP tool-call log on the left driving a live Brekka Grid dispatch card on the right.
